a.lede: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.
a.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe

b.lede: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.
b.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
